summary: A label used by some trading frameworks for price movement beyond a previously identified structural reference. Exact rules vary across frameworks.

definition.description: A provisional descriptive concept for a price move that crosses a previously identified swing or structural level. This record does not assume that the move predicts continuation, reversal, or profitable trades.
definition.operationalization: Not yet standardized. A reproducible implementation must define how swing points are identified, whether levels use wicks or closes, when the level becomes known, and how intrabar crossings are handled.
definition.decision_timing: Unspecified until a particular implementation defines confirmation and availability time.

claims.statement: The phrase is used with differing operational definitions across trading frameworks.
claims.scope: Provisional editorial observation; requires source review before being marked supported.
claims.notes: Do not present this statement as a completed literature review.

limitations: No source review has yet been completed for this entry.
